stories.title: Russian Defense Ministry delegation discusses cooperation with its Indian colleagues
stories.summary: MOSCOW, August 23. A Russian Defense Ministry delegation has taken part in a meeting of a working subgroup on planning military cooperation between Russia and India, according to the website of the Russian Defense Ministry. "On August 20-22, 2026, in the city of New Delhi, a delegation of the Main Directorate for International Military Cooperation of the Defense Ministry of the Russian Federation took part in a meeting of the working subgroup on planning military cooperation of the Russian-Indian intergovernmental commission on military and military-technical cooperation," the ministry said. During the negotiations, issues and prospects for the development of defense cooperation were discussed.
